# Feature: Lantern oil — sanity check

<!-- Generated by the project-manager tool from pm.yml. Do not edit by hand; the store is the source of truth. -->

## Goal

Sanity-check candidate mechanic #65 (Lantern oil) from Gear and Items before it is used in real levels. Effect: collect to keep your light burning. Unique: a consumable that refuels light, not time or health. Useful: makes long dark levels a resource route, not a rush. Source status in the candidate file is 'trial'.

## User Story

**As a** player

**I want** collect to keep your light burning.

**So that** makes long dark levels a resource route, not a rush.

## High-Level Use Case

The player meets Lantern oil for the first time in its teaching room (mech-65-lantern-oil-room). Teaching moment: First room: a dark room with oil near the entrance and the search area beyond it. A player who walks past the oil to save time finds their light shrunk before the far orbs appear and has to feel their way back, which teaches that oil is the route through a dark room rather than a bonus beside it. The sanity check plays that room, exercises every rule below, and records a replayable session.

## Player-Facing Behavior

- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: A pickup that refills the lantern
- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: In a dark room the lantern burns down over time shown on a conditional HUD gauge
- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: Oil restores it to full, without it the light shrinks back to the base radius

## Edge Cases & Rules

- Movement/state stays deterministic: state advances only through the pure step function with recorded t_ms; a recorded session replays to the same end state.
- Restart (R / restart) restores the room to its initial state, including this mechanic.

## UI / Feedback

- The player sees Lantern oil's effect happen on its tile(s) exactly as the rules above describe; no hidden state.
- Any counter, inventory or HUD impact follows the rules above; if a rule needs a counter it is shown while it matters (see Open Questions).
- Failure in the teaching room returns the player to the room start / checkpoint for an immediate retry.

## Assets & Level Data Needed

- Level JSON: new Test Level mech-65-lantern-oil-room (rows + legend) implementing the teaching moment above.
- Sprites/defs: reuse existing tiles where the mechanic reuses an existing tile; add a new sprite/tile def only if this mechanic introduces a new tile (confirm in the implement task).
- Source: plans/level-design/candidate-mechanics/gear-and-items.yml mechanic #65.
